visual_concept: Illustrate the trade‑off between raw data, parsing/validation, structured, semi‑structured, and unstructured data flows in a data pipeline.
image_prompt: Flat 2D technical vector diagram, orthographic view, deep navy background (#050B14). Thin cool‑grey infrastructure lines (#8A99AD). One centered focal architecture: a raw data cylinder feeding into a parse/validate node, then branching into three parallel paths: a structured database cylinder, a semi‑structured stream block, and an unstructured file block. Each path ends in a storage block that connects to an analytics/ML node. Bright cyan (#00E5FF) arrows show active data flow, highlighting a bottleneck at the validation node. White (#FFFFFF) for limited structural contrast. High negative space (~60%). No text, labels, numbers, or decorative elements.
negative_prompt: text, labels, numbers, code snippets, UI screenshots, excessive glow, cyberpunk, 3D renders, realistic textures, photorealistic people, rainbow colors, floating icons without system relationships, duplicate nodes, arbitrary arrows, decorative elements, generic corporate stock graphics
accessibility_alt_text: A flat 2‑D diagram showing a data pipeline that starts with a raw data source, flows through a parse/validate stage, then splits into three parallel paths—structured, semi‑structured, and unstructured—each ending in a storage block that feeds into analytics or ML components, with bright cyan arrows indicating active data flow and a bottleneck at the validation stage.
